recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片中箭頭指出咬痕細胞（bite cell）與水泡細胞（blister cell），另有紅血球鬼影（ghost）、半鬼影（hemighost）與球形紅血球，這組氧化性溶血變化配合吃蠶豆史，指向 G6PD 缺乏的蠶豆症。
features: Numerous bite cells and blister cells with hemoglobin retracted to one side (arrows)
Red cell ghosts with lost hemoglobin (arrowheads) and hemighosts (carets)
Occasional echinocytes and polychromatic red cells
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked red cell changes of oxidative hemolysis, including numerous bite cells and blister (eccentrocyte-like) cells, red cell ghosts, hemighosts and scattered spherocytes. Occasional polychromatic cells are present, consistent with a reticulocyte response. Platelets are adequate and no schistocytes or red cell agglutination are evident. Findings are consistent with acute oxidative hemolysis, as seen in G6PD deficiency (favism); a Heinz body preparation and G6PD assay, preferably after recovery, are recommended.

ddx.vs: Spherocytes predominate without bite cells, blister cells or ghosts, and the course is chronic rather than an acute trigger-related crisis.
Characterized by schistocytes (helmet cells, triangles) with thrombocytopenia rather than bite and blister cells.
Also shows bite cells and Heinz bodies, but G6PD activity is normal and hemoglobin stability testing is abnormal.
Shows spherocytes with a positive direct antiglobulin test, without oxidative bite/blister cells or hemighosts.
